attributes.description: Reads the core estate domain's boundaries, POA&M items, exceptions, assessments and control responsibilities; defines no schema. The evidence-package MANIFEST hook (assessment_results_document evidence=) is for task 526's `opsdir evidence`.
attributes.external_dependencies: ["NIST OSCAL 1.2.3 JSON schema (validation test only, tools/oscal/1.2.3 from fetch-tools.sh)", "jsonschema (validation test only)"]
attributes.purpose: OSCAL for opsdir (written against OSCAL 1.2.3, readers accept 1.x): the oscal-json format; pure writers of a system boundary's POA&M and SSP and of a compliance assessment's assessment results (UNBOUND fields named in notes, uuid5 ids, deterministic); readers of OSCAL POA&Ms, assessment results (per-document containers, record items merged in place, never deleted) and catalogs (checked, not imported); the declaration-only `oscal` compliance adapter rendering oscal/*.json.

attributes.name: uid
attributes.purpose: A version-5 UUID of the parts (opsdir's OSCAL namespace): the same parts give the same id.

attributes.name: entry_uid
attributes.purpose: The UUID of what an entry is written as (kind: poam-item, risk, finding, ...), by its normalized DN and more parts: the same entry is the same object in every document and revision.

attributes.name: unbound
attributes.purpose: The UNBOUND:<what> mark written where OSCAL requires a value the record doesn't hold.

attributes.name: slug
attributes.purpose: A file or container name of free text: lower case, runs of other characters as '-' (unnamed when empty).

attributes.name: iso
attributes.purpose: The OSCAL date-time of a GeneralizedTime (20261102000000Z -> 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z), or None.

attributes.name: day_iso
attributes.purpose: The OSCAL date-time (midnight UTC) of a day, or None when not a date.

attributes.name: last_modified
attributes.purpose: When documented entries last changed as the record dates them (latest of the attrs), else the day given, else EPOCH: never the time of writing.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.purpose: An OSCAL metadata block (title, last-modified, version: the given one else last-modified, oscal-version OSCAL_VERSION).

attributes.name: prop
attributes.purpose: An opsdir OSCAL property (namespace NS) of a name and value.

attributes.name: props
attributes.purpose: opsdir properties of (name, value) pairs whose value is held, in order.

attributes.name: prop_values
attributes.purpose: The values of an OSCAL object's properties of a name in opsdir's namespace (or none).

attributes.name: prop_value
attributes.purpose: The first value of an OSCAL object's opsdir property of a name, or None.

attributes.name: is_53
attributes.purpose: Whether a framework's controls are SP 800-53's (nist-800-53-*, fedramp-*).

attributes.name: control_id
attributes.purpose: (framework, OSCAL control id) of a record control ref: SP 800-53 lower case with enhancements dotted (AC-2(1) -> ac-2.1), digit-led ids behind '_' (interim), others as recorded.

attributes.name: control_ref
attributes.purpose: The record control ref of an OSCAL control id under a framework: control_id's inverse.

attributes.name: is_token
attributes.purpose: Whether text is an OSCAL token (XML NCName), what a control id must be.

attributes.name: oscal_version_major
attributes.purpose: The major OSCAL version an OSCAL document's metadata states, or None.

attributes.name: unbound_note
attributes.purpose: The action RenderNote naming the UNBOUND fields of a document, for the owner of the entry it documents.

attributes.name: boundaries
attributes.purpose: The operator's system boundaries (ciamSystemBoundary under ou=boundaries), by name.

attributes.name: environments
attributes.purpose: The normalized DNs of the environments an entry names (ciamAffectedEnvironment).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.purpose: The sorted cloud/env labels of environment DNs.

attributes.name: system_id
attributes.purpose: The id a boundary's OSCAL documents carry: its ciamSspRef, else its name.

attributes.name: boundary_items
attributes.purpose: The POA&M items naming an environment inside a boundary, by name.

attributes.name: boundary_exceptions
attributes.purpose: The requested or approved exceptions (deviations) naming an environment inside a boundary, by name.

attributes.name: item_exceptions
attributes.purpose: The exceptions belonging to a POA&M item (ciamPoamRef).

attributes.name: boundary_responsibilities
attributes.purpose: (authorization, responsibility) for each control responsibility under an authorization an environment inside the boundary relies on (ciamAuthorizationRef), by authorization and name.

attributes.name: assessments
attributes.purpose: The compliance assessments (ciamComplianceAssessment), by name.

attributes.name: assessment_items
attributes.purpose: An assessment's open POA&M items: those whose ciamAssessmentRef is its name or its own reference.

attributes.name: poam_document
attributes.purpose: OscalDoc of a system boundary's OSCAL POA&M: poam-items and one risk each (status, deadline, milestone tasks), its requested/approved exceptions as deviation risks, system-id from ciamSspRef; refused without an item.

attributes.name: has_ssp
attributes.purpose: Whether a system boundary has an SSP to write: a control responsibility (OSCAL-token id) under an authorization its environments rely on.

attributes.name: ssp_document
attributes.purpose: OscalDoc of a system boundary's OSCAL SSP: system characteristics, this-system and authorization components, one implemented requirement per control with by-components by responsibility; UNBOUND profile, information types, status; refused without a requirement.

attributes.name: assessment_results_document
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "a", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "as_of", "type": "datetime.date|None", "required": false}, {"name": "evidence", "type": "tuple[tuple[str, str]]", "required": false, "description": "(path, sha256) of an evidence package's MANIFEST"}]
attributes.purpose: OscalDoc of a compliance assessment's OSCAL assessment results: one result (framework, kind, score, status props), its open POA&M items as not-satisfied findings, evidence package files (SHA-256) and ciamEvidenceRef as back-matter; UNBOUND import-ap.

attributes.name: read_poam
attributes.purpose: Importer oscal/poam: each OSCAL 1.x POA&M's items as POA&M items of the system boundary its system-id names (refused when none); new ones in ou=oscal-poam-<system id>,ou=poam, record-owned ones merged in place, never deleted.

attributes.name: read_assessment_results
attributes.purpose: Importer oscal/assessment-results: results stating framework and kind as compliance assessments, not-satisfied findings as open POA&M items, in per-document containers under ou=assessments and ou=poam.

attributes.name: catalog_ids
attributes.purpose: The ids of every control in an OSCAL catalog (groups' and controls' controls at any depth).

attributes.name: read_catalog
attributes.purpose: Importer oscal/catalog: imports nothing; notices name, per framework whose controls the catalog holds, the record's controls it doesn't.

attributes.name: oscal_documents
attributes.purpose: {path: OscalDoc} of every OSCAL document the record gives: oscal/<boundary>/poam.json and ssp.json where they have content, oscal/assessment-results-<assessment>.json.

attributes.name: render_oscal
attributes.purpose: The oscal adapter's environment-neutral render: every OSCAL document the record gives, as indented JSON.

attributes.name: oscal_notes
attributes.purpose: The oscal adapter's render notes (Adapter.notes): each document's UNBOUND notes, the documents not written, the frameworks with interim control ids.

attributes.description: A document opsdir wrote as OSCAL: the OSCAL JSON value and the RenderNotes naming what it holds UNBOUND or leaves out.
attributes.name: OscalDoc

attributes.description: Milestone 28 (6.2a; decision 3029, proposal 3024). New package packages/opsdir-format-oscal (no vendor named; like opsdir-format-arm/-cloudformation: registered format(s) under opsdir.formats). Writers from the record: OSCAL POA&M from ciamPoamItem (+ risk exceptions as deviations/risks), SSP control implementations from ciamControlResponsibility + ciamSystemBoundary (+ evidence queries once task 6.2a-1 lands: design the hook, link by control id), assessment-results back-matter linking an evidence package MANIFEST. Readers: assessment-results and POA&M imported into ciamComplianceAssessment / ciamPoamItem (matched by control id + the tool's object id as ciamFindingRef provider:kind:id; a sync never deletes record-owned items; preview with take/keep conflicts as every importer), catalog/profile reader validating control ids. OSCAL VERSION AND SCHEMA: the master is researching the current OSCAL release with Codex; design against OSCAL's model as you know it, escalate the version question, and validate against the official JSON schema once the master pins and fetches it (fetch-tools.sh, SHA-256 pinned, like the AS3 schema). Deterministic output (sorted, stable UUIDs derived from DNs, e.g. uuid5) for golden. Rules 2991 + 3002. Escalate design choices with a recommendation (the master answers). Boundary: packages/opsdir-format-oscal (src, tests, README, pyproject), opsdir/scripts/dev-install picks it up automatically; the estate domain only to read existing classes (no schema changes: worker-3's task owns them). NOT operations.py/CLI (worker-3 wires `evidence`; you expose functions the CLI/import machinery can call), not 6.4's files.
attributes.name: 6.2a-2: opsdir-format-oscal package (writers and readers)

attributes.description: format.py FORMAT (oscal-json, application/json); common.py OSCAL_VERSION=1.2.3 per master's pin (msg 89f13467), NS urn:opsdir:oscal, uuid5 ids, iso times, metadata, control ids (800-53 lower/dotted, digit-led '_' interim), UNBOUND notes.
attributes.name: oscal-json format + OSCAL_VERSION 1.2.3

attributes.description: POA&M per system boundary (items + one risk each, deviation risks from requested/approved exceptions, milestones as remediation tasks); SSP (this-system + authorization components, implemented requirements with by-components by responsibility); AR (one result, open items as not-satisfied findings, evidence MANIFEST hook as back-matter with SHA-256). All validate against NIST's OSCAL 1.2.3 complete schema.
attributes.name: Writers: poam_document, ssp_document, assessment_results_document

attributes.description: Per-document containers ou=oscal-poam-<system id>,ou=poam and ou=oscal-ar-<doc uuid> under ou=assessments/ou=poam; record items matched by record-dn or ciamFindingRef oscal:<kind>:<uuid>, merged in place, never deleted; own export re-imported changes nothing; catalog checked, not imported; secrets withheld.
attributes.name: Readers: oscal/poam, oscal/assessment-results, oscal/catalog

attributes.description: render_neutral writes oscal/<boundary>/poam.json, ssp.json, oscal/assessment-results-<assessment>.json; notes: UNBOUND fields, documents not written, interim control ids per framework.
attributes.name: oscal adapter (declaration-only, compliance)

attributes.description: test_writers.py, test_readers.py (incl. estate poam_rows/assessment_rows/check_poam see container items: subtree), test_oscal_schema.py (marker oscal, registered in the package conftest; skipped without tools/oscal/1.2.3). README with Known limits (1.2.3, not FedRAMP CR26 output, interim 800-171 ids, UNBOUND fields).
